title: Phase C — 16 points on 5 screens
lead: Nothing is built yet. Each numbered point is one problem on today's master and one fix. Click Yes or No per point; I build the Yeses and bring the same cards back with a Before/After flip.

points.what: The active card grows a second line and its neighbour stretches to match — an empty strip with a floating pencil (Dark 65 px vs Crème 34 px).
points.fix: Put “active” on the name line, so every card is one height.

points.what: The pencil on a built-in opens a 588 px dialog that holds one sentence (“Built-in themes are locked…”).
points.fix: Grey out the pencil on the four built-ins, with a tooltip saying why; community themes keep a live pencil (they have glass sliders).
points.why: All four built-ins are flat-colour themes, so the editor has no sliders to show — only the locked notice. Alternative: hide the pencil entirely; I recommend against it because the tooltip is the only place the why gets explained.

points.what: “Browse all themes →” and “Browse Theme Marketplace” sound like the same thing; they open different screens (your installed themes vs the Marketplace).
points.fix: Rename them “All installed themes →” and “Get more themes”.
points.why: The ledger claimed both open the same screen — wrong on checking: the first opens Your Library › Themes (the grid above only shows starred themes), the second the Marketplace.

points.what: Three stacked full-width buttons in three styles; the first is a hand-rolled fourth style the shared Button does not have.
points.fix: The first becomes a quiet text-link row under the grid, leaving one primary (Build) and one secondary (Get more themes).

more.note: What the pencil opens on a built-in — the whole dialog.

points.what: The featured card's border is a hardcoded gold in every theme (the other two featured entries bring their own blue and green).
points.fix: Border = the theme's normal card edge; the entry's colour is dropped.
points.why: The guide's T-1 alternative — let the entry colour tint only the small FEATURED eyebrow and the dot pager — keeps a non-theme colour alive for a 12 px label; I would not. Risk: a featured entry can no longer colour the hero; that was never a documented feature.
points.risk: Featured entries lose the ability to colour the hero (undocumented; three entries use it).

points.what: Theme cards: the text ends at five different heights across seven cards — the description and the likes line only render when present.
points.fix: Reserve the two description lines and the counts row, so every card's text ends in the same place.
Pluralise properly (two places in the card).

more.note: Themes tab: cards 1, 2 and 6 stop at the author line; the rest run on.

items.title: Your Library, nothing installed
items.surface: Library — what every new install sees

points.what: Two headings over nothing — no sentence, no button. The empty-state sentence in the code has never rendered once: a counting bug makes every section think it has content.
points.fix: Fix the bug (+ pinning test) and use the app's shared empty block: “Nothing installed yet” with a Browse the Marketplace button; Favorites gets a one-liner.
points.why: Section decides “has content?” with React.Children.count(children), and the child is written condition && <grid> — when false that still counts as one child. Same shared EmptyState block that Settings → Permissions, the session drawer and the Resume browser use. Nothing changes for a Library with content.

points.what: The Skills | Themes switcher is two plain 12 px pills under a 22 px title; Projects uses bordered icon + count tabs.
points.fix: Leave it — decide tabs app-wide in a later phase. (My recommendation: No.)

points.what: Plugins / Themes (pick one) is drawn exactly like the eleven filters after it (pick any).
points.fix: Plugins / Themes becomes the app's two-position switch, in the same spot; the filters stay pills.
points.why: The ledger called New / Popular / Featured picks “sorts” and wanted a dropdown — wrong: they are on/off filters like the categories. So there are two kinds of control here, not three, and no sort menu is proposed.

points.what: The search box has no magnifier and is shorter than the pills beside it.
points.fix: The shared search-field shape with its icon.

points.what: When nothing matches: “0 results” and “Nothing matches those filters.” at once, and no way to clear the filters.
points.fix: One empty state with a Clear filters button.

points.what: “Explore everything” with nothing under it while the registry loads — or forever, if it cannot be reached.
points.fix: Placeholder cards while loading; the shared error block with Retry when unreachable.

points.what: Phone width: the title truncates to “Ma…” because the right-hand controls take their full width first.
points.fix: The title keeps its word; the controls shrink first.

points.what: Projects is the only full screen that hides the theme wallpaper — its root paints an opaque canvas; Library and Marketplace let it through.
points.fix: Same transparent root as its siblings. Built-in themes look identical (flat canvas anyway).
points.risk: Header readability over a busy wallpaper — the card is already a glass panel like the Marketplace hero; the review will show all six themes.

points.what: Two accent-filled buttons in one card: New Conversation and Turn on sync for this project.
points.fix: Turn on sync becomes the small secondary button inside its chip — one accent per card, per the guide.

closing:
Checked and left alone

  • Projects: Rename / Remove are already the shared small button; the folder “tab” was reworked to your 2026-07-19 feedback; document previews are the intended thumbnail look.
  • Marketplace: no sort dropdown (there is no sort).
  • Themes dialog: the two toggles at the bottom.
